positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Working on developing scalable, fault-tolerant microservices within an event driven architecture leveraging Apache Kafka.

positions.title: Digital Technology Leadership Program (DTLP) | MyTech
positions.description: • Rebuilding and redesigning a web application from the ground up using React, Redux, and Typescript

positions.title: Digital Technology Leadership Program (DTLP) | Predix Edge Application Services
positions.description:
• Created the Predix Industrial Gateway Server (IGS) Protocol Adapter in C++ that will enable users to subscribe to OPC-DA data sources and consume the data into their Predix Edge environment
• Developed unit tests with reusable C++ Google Test fixtures
• Created automated build and Artifactory deployments using Jenkins
• Selected as one of the top 3 teams in the 2019 Predix Edge Hackathon for implementing and presenting a solution that enhanced the existing Predix Edge Manager Intelligent Data Pump Designer (IDPD). Our solution will be productized and released in 2019

positions.title: Digital Technology Leadership Program (DTLP) | Predix Event Hub
positions.description:
• Built a canary monitoring system in Go
• Designed and implemented a solution to provide metrics to users in Go
• Maintained and added features to the Java SDK
• Created automated Artifactory deployments using Jenkins

positions.title: Digital Technology Leadership Program (DTLP) | Data and Analytics Platform
positions.description:
• Worked with a Data and Analytics team to develop the Monitoring Strategy for the Data and Analytics Platform using AWS and New Relic
• Worked with manager to develop a proof of concept for a meeting time analytics Add-In for Microsoft Outlook

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
University of Florida Human Experience Research Lab (HXR)

Collaborated with PhD candidate on developing a Human-Computer Interaction study by helping develop study instructions, performing initial data processing, and doing qualitative data analysis

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
University of Florida Broward Teaching Center

Assisted students in Circuits 1, Digital Logic and Computer Systems, and Calculus II/III in private and walk-in style sessions

Led and assisted with exam reviews for Calculus II to groups of over 50 students.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
University of Florida Human Experience Research Lab (HXR)

Collaborated as a developer of the application that enabled communication between the EMOTIV Insight Brainwear device (Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) device) and the DJI Phantom 3 Pro drone, allowing the participants in the first-ever Brain Drone Race to compete by controlling the drones with their minds
